title: Confidence-gated act, ask or escalate
description: Decide whether an agent should act now, ask a clarifying question, or escalate, given how ambiguous or risky the request is

planned_action.description: the concrete command or diff; the blast-radius read needs it

profile.description: the action class, chosen by code: read_only, reversible_write, irreversible; strict = irreversible

steps.state_template: Agent about to run on the production host: `{{planned_action}}`

blast.instructions: How large is the blast radius if this command runs?
criteria: small: changes one local file, trivially restorable
large: changes shared state, restore is slow or partial

go.instructions: Should the agent proceed with the request as written, or ask a clarifying question first?

criteria.proceed: Only one reasonable interpretation, or all interpretations have the same safe effect; act now
criteria.ask: Several plausible interpretations with different (possibly destructive) consequences; ask first

combine: escalate if go.p < escalate_p; escalate if blast >= blast_escalate; act if go == 'proceed' and go.p >= act_p and go.p >= proceed_min; ask otherwise
limitations: noul answers are near-binary; grey values mainly with thin evidence
the state must contain the resolved command, not only the request (pass planned_action)
domain-choice confidence is not an ambiguity detector (gate-19 known limitation)
the correct noul (fix input), the risk choice when no action class is given and the stricter 0.95 for auto-applied code are not built: the engine has no input-conditional steps or thresholds
notes: # deviation: spec 5.2: action_class is the `profile` input (the engine selects policy and questions by profile only); the blast read runs only when go == 'proceed'
